infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tracy’s Room Muse uses your camera to capture the room you want to redesign.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Tracy’s Room Muse uses your microphone to include sound when you record a room video.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Tracy’s Room Muse lets you choose room photos for a design concept.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Tracy’s Room Muse to scan and photograph your room.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Tracy’s Room Muse to record sound with a room video.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Tracy’s Room Muse to select a room photo.
